items.exampleEn: He obsesses about what other people think of him.
items.exampleZh: 他過分在意別人怎麼看他。

items.exampleEn: In this sentence, the referent of "she" is the teacher.
items.exampleZh: 在這個句子裡，「她」指的是那位老師。

items.exampleEn: Is this plan achievable in such a short time?
items.exampleZh: 在這麼短的時間內，這個計畫做得到嗎？

items.exampleEn: The museum, regrettably, is closed on Mondays.
items.exampleZh: 很可惜，那間博物館每週一休館。

items.exampleEn: The cat seemed unconcerned by the loud noise.
items.exampleZh: 那隻貓似乎對巨大的聲響毫不在意。

items.exampleEn: The strange lights in the sky mystified everyone.
items.exampleZh: 天空中奇怪的光讓大家都很困惑。

items.exampleEn: A pessimist expects the worst to happen.
items.exampleZh: 悲觀的人總是預期最壞的事會發生。

items.exampleEn: She read the contract attentively before signing it.
items.exampleZh: 她在簽約前仔細地讀了合約。

items.sentenceEn: Our flight has regrettably been canceled because of fog.
items.sentenceZh: 很遺憾，我們的班機因為起霧已經取消了。

items.audioEn: How the magician did the trick still mystifies me.
items.audioZh: 那位魔術師是怎麼變那個魔術的，我到現在還想不通。
items.questionZh: 說話者對那個魔術的感覺是什麼？
options: The magician told me the trick
I did the same trick at home
The trick was easy to see

items.sentenceEn: Don't listen to him; he's a pessimist about everything.
items.sentenceZh: 別聽他的，他對什麼事都很悲觀。

items.sentenceEn: Ask yourself what the referent of each pronoun is.
items.sentenceZh: 問問自己，每個代名詞指的是什麼。

items.stemEn: With more practice, winning the school singing contest is ____.
items.stemZh: 多練習一點，贏得學校歌唱比賽是做得到的。

items.stemEn: Try not to ____ over small mistakes; everyone makes them.
items.stemZh: 別為小錯誤一直糾結，每個人都會犯錯。

items.passageEn: At fifty, my aunt decided to learn the piano. Her teacher told her to set small, achievable goals, like learning one short song a month. My aunt listened attentively in every lesson, and she practiced every evening. My cousin, who is a pessimist, said she would give up within a month, but my aunt seemed unconcerned. What mystified all of us was how fast she got better. Regrettably, her old piano was a bit shaky and out of tune, so she bought a new one. Now she obsesses over playing a difficult piece for my grandmother's birthday.
items.passageZh: 五十歲那年，我阿姨決定學鋼琴。老師要她定一些小而做得到的目標，例如每個月學會一首短曲。阿姨每堂課都很專心聽，每天晚上也都練習。我表哥是個悲觀的人，他說阿姨不到一個月就會放棄，但阿姨似乎一點也不在意。讓我們大家都想不通的是，她怎麼進步得那麼快。可惜她那台舊鋼琴有點不穩，音也不準，所以她買了一台新的。現在她一心想在奶奶生日時彈一首很難的曲子。

options: 每天晚上至少練習三個小時
定一些小而做得到的目標

questions.questionZh: 阿姨為什麼買了新鋼琴？
options: 老師要她換一台比較好的
她想在生日派對上表演
舊鋼琴被表哥不小心弄壞了

items.promptZh: 他對明天的考試毫不在意。
referenceEn: He is unconcerned about tomorrow's exam.
He seems completely unconcerned about the exam tomorrow.
rubricZh: unconcerned 的用法，例如 unconcerned about 等
時態合理（例如 is、seems 等）

items.promptZh: 只要每天練習，三個月學會彈十首吉他曲是做得到的。
referenceEn: With daily practice, learning ten songs on the guitar in three months is achievable.
If you practice every day, learning ten guitar songs in three months is an achievable goal.
rubricZh: achievable 放在 be 動詞後或名詞前（例如 is achievable、an achievable goal 等）
「只要每天練習」可寫，例如 with daily practice、if you practice every day 等
